details.title: How It Works
details.intro: This scanner checks product ingredients using OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and our curated halal ingredient database.

steps.ocr: OCR Processing – The product image (taken by camera or uploaded from gallery) is sent to an OCR server, which reads and extracts the ingredient text from the image.
steps.translate: Translation – If the detected text is in Chinese, it is sent to Google Translation to be converted into English for consistent checking.
steps.match: Database Matching – The translated English ingredient list is checked against our curated database of keywords for halal, Muslim-friendly, syubhah, and haram indicators.
steps.display: Result Display – Any matches are highlighted by category with their status shown for your reference.

muslimFriendly.examples: Examples: Lecithin (Soy), Soy Lecithin, Emulsifier (Sugar Cane), Fresh Cream

syubhah.label: Syubhah
syubhah.desc: Doubtful or unclear ingredients that may need further checking.
syubhah.examples: Examples: Unknown Emulsifier, Butter, Margarine, Vinegar
